subject: Fastest air freight option to SGN
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN)?

The furniture samples will be ready for pickup at our site in 64344 (Darmstadt), Germany, on 2026-11-24. It’s 3 pieces with a gross weight of 753 kg and a total volume of 4.87 cbm. Please include the truck from our site to the airport in your quote.

Could you also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer? Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
